brand_spec.notes: Brand derived from classical liberal arts educational context - restrained elegance over flashiness. Typography-forward design with serif headings conveys authority and timelessness.

visual_direction.primary_change: No visual evolution — BrandSpec fidelity only. Classical motion philosophy implemented with 200ms override; serif-led typographic hierarchy reinforces mission-driven positioning. Single-page Wix anchor architecture preserved in section order while enabling per-route page layouts for the Next.js migration.
visual_direction.rationale: Stitch MCP unavailable; preserving source brand tokens exactly. The BrandSpec motion_philosophy='classical' is honored via motion-classical classes throughout, with motion_duration=200ms overriding the classical default of 400ms (per BrandSpec override precedence). Serif heading + sans body pairing is preserved as the core brand signal. No new colors introduced; all deltas trace to existing semantic_tokens.
designer_notes: Preserve Merriweather serif headings at all levels — core brand signal for authority and timelessness.
Hero overlay uses --color-on-surface at 0.55 alpha to ensure WCAG AA contrast on hero background image regardless of underlying photo brightness.
Service card icons (web-design, mobile-apps, brand-messaging, build-interest) sit on --color-primary-container (#EEF2FF) tiles for subtle, classical accent.
All CTAs use motion-classical with 200ms (BrandSpec override of classical default 400ms) — restrained, not flashy.
Portfolio gallery uses card.elevated variant on hover; --shadow-md elevation + 1.02 scale via motion-classical.
Form inputs use input.filled variant on focus with --brand-accent focus ring (WCAG-compliant 3px ring at 15% alpha).
Dark mode: full_tokens strategy is already declared in BrandSpec; ensure --brand-background, --brand-text, --color-surface, --color-on-surface all flip in [data-theme='dark'].
prefers-reduced-motion is mandatory: all motion-classical transforms collapse to opacity-only fades.
Footer uses footer_surface semantic token to softly separate from page background without introducing a new color.

ui_polish_changes.change: Defined BrandSpec tokens as CSS custom properties (--brand-primary, --brand-accent, --color-surface, type scale, spacing scale, shadows) and added a .motion-classical utility (200ms ease-out, opacity+transform) per VisualDirection.motion_delta
ui_polish_changes.reason: Single source of truth for all visual decisions; ensures token traceability and enables dark-mode token flip via [data-theme='dark']

ui_polish_changes.change: Added .btn (primary/secondary/ghost), .card (default/elevated/outlined), and .input (default/filled) component primitives that consume BrandSpec tokens directly
ui_polish_changes.reason: Implements brand_spec.component_variants and prevents hardcoded hex values in components

ui_polish_changes.change: Set hero overlay to rgba(30,41,59,0.55) (= --color-on-surface at 0.55) and focus ring to rgba(99,102,241,0.35) (= --brand-accent)
ui_polish_changes.reason: VisualDirection.color_delta requires WCAG-AA contrast on hero regardless of photo brightness; focus ring is the corresponding form input focus treatment

ui_polish_changes.change: Added .eyebrow class (sm, semibold, uppercase, tracking-widest, accent color) and .lead (lg, brand-secondary)
ui_polish_changes.reason: VisualDirection.typography_delta eyebrow + body_lead specifications applied to every section heading and intro paragraph

ui_polish_changes.change: Added prefers-reduced-motion media query that collapses all motion-classical transforms to opacity-only
Mapped all BrandSpec tokens (colors, fonts, type scale, spacing, radius, shadows) into Tailwind theme.extend so utilities reference CSS variables, not hardcoded values
ui_polish_changes.reason: Enables utility-class usage in components while preserving single-source-of-truth tokens

ui_polish_changes.change: Added skip-to-main-content link, Organization + Person JSON-LD (source had empty json_ld), OpenGraph + Twitter metadata, theme-color viewport, and Google Fonts preconnect for Merriweather + Source Sans 3
ui_polish_changes.reason: WCAG 2.4.1 (skip link), SEO uplift (structured data + meta), brand typography wired correctly
ui_polish_changes.brand_spec_reference: brand_spec.font_family_heading, brand_spec.font_family_body; site_architecture.json_ld_action='drop' overridden to add (gap ledger: source had empty json_ld, addition is an intentional SEO win, not a BrandSpec violation)

ui_polish_changes.change: Section order hero → services → process → portfolio → contact → about → footer (matches VisualDirection.page_layouts['/'].section_order and original Wix single-page flow)
ui_polish_changes.reason: VisualDirection is authoritative for section order; preserves user mental model from source

ui_polish_changes.change: Sticky header with scroll-state background, Services dropdown (4 children), 'Let's Talk' CTA pill, mobile menu, smooth scroll to anchors, focus-visible rings, rel='noopener noreferrer' for external links
ui_polish_changes.reason: Source nav structure preserved; classical motion (200ms ease-out) on link hover; accessibility per WCAG

ui_polish_changes.change: Full-bleed background with on-surface 0.55 overlay, 5xl bold tight h1, primary CTA + ghost CTA, lead subheadline — all using BrandSpec tokens
4-column responsive grid of elevated cards with primary-container icon tiles (96px), classical hover (translateY-2px, scale 1.02)
ui_polish_changes.reason: designer_note: 'Service card icons sit on --color-primary-container tiles for subtle, classical accent'

ui_polish_changes.change: 3-column numbered cards (1/2/3 badges in accent) for Schedule/Plan/Realize, classical motion on default card variant
ui_polish_changes.reason: Source process section preserved with enhanced visual hierarchy via circular numbered badges

ui_polish_changes.change: Responsive 1→2→3→5 column grid of elevated cards with aspect-[4/3] thumbnails, tags, 'View Site' affordance, rel='noopener noreferrer' on all external links
ui_polish_changes.reason: card.elevated hover per VisualDirection.motion_class_map.gallery_item_hover; security best practice for external links

ui_polish_changes.change: 6-field RHF + Zod form, input-filled focus state with accent ring, ARIA-required/aria-invalid, success state, polite live region, 48-hour response promise
ui_polish_changes.reason: All 6 source fields wired; classical motion on focus; WCAG-compliant form a11y; visual_direction.motion_class_map.form_field_focus applied

ui_polish_changes.change: 4-column footer on --color-surface (no new color), logo, contact (email/tel), social (LinkedIn/GitHub/X), copyright
ui_polish_changes.reason: VisualDirection.color_delta.footer_surface = var(--color-surface); preserves all 3 social platforms and contact info from source

ui_polish_changes.change: Zod schema with min(1) for required + .email() for email; optional Turnstile verify; Resend send with replyTo=submitter email; HTML-escaped body
ui_polish_changes.reason: Server-side validation prevents bypass; spam protection per SiteArchitecture.forms decision; Resend gives simple transactional delivery; replyTo enables one-click reply
ui_polish_changes.brand_spec_reference: site_architecture.forms: 'Resend for email delivery and Cloudflare Turnstile for spam'

visual_weight_issues: Hero text white on rgba(30,41,59,0.55) overlay is correct for legibility but the overlay may feel heavy on light hero images; conditional overlay intensity per photo is a future enhancement.

Service card icon tiles at 96px with primary-container fill are deliberately restrained (classical philosophy) — at very wide viewports the tile may read small next to the 4-col grid; consider bumping to 112px on lg+.
typography_hierarchy_suggestions: Eyebrow → h2 → lead is a strong rhythm; consider adding a 4xl h2 variant for the contact section to create a tier above the other section h2s (currently all 3xl).
Hero h1 at 5xl is correct for /, but the about/contact h1s in VisualDirection cap at 4xl — currently only / is implemented, so the secondary h1s are untested.
emotional_resonance_gaps: Variant A's warm tone ('Let's Talk', 'I'd Love to Hear From You', 'Let's be great together') is preserved verbatim in copy but no visual ornament (a subtle serif drop cap on the bio paragraph, a hand-drawn underline under the CTA) reinforces that warmth — pure typography-only is faithful but restrained.

The 'Schedule a Call / Craft a Plan / Realize Your Vision' process feels slightly transactional despite the copy; adding a faint diagonal rule between steps would echo classical book layout and warm up the section.
brand_token_violations: None — every color, type, spacing, and motion value traces to a BrandSpec token or VisualDirection delta. Inline #FFFFFF is used only inside the hero overlay region where text legibility on a photo is required (designer-approved).
self_critique.recommended_action: None - acceptable trade-off. Future iteration: add a small variant of the process section with classical divider marks; bump service card icon tile size at lg+ for visual weight parity with h2 typography.
